subject: Can you join us in Brighton East this Wednesday?
preheader: Forté mattress selection and pressure care with Craig Gorman. 21 October, 10 am to noon. Register here.
trialFooterText: Sleep Choice covers the seven-night in-home trial at no cost to the participant.
intro: We’d love to see you at our in-person Forté session on Wednesday 21 October.
Craig Gorman will join the Sleep Choice team for a practical morning on pressure care and clinical mattress selection, including static, hybrid and powered support surfaces.
sectionTitle: Two hours. Practical discussion. Your questions.
body: Explore the technologies, discuss their application in everyday OT practice and learn how Sleep Choice’s seven-night home trials can support bed and mattress assessment.
If you can make it, register below. If a colleague would benefit, please pass the invitation on.
detail: In-person OT training · Craig Gorman · 2 CPD points
